analyses.trigger_concept: A "magic knock" sequence detector hooked on the existing new_sample strobe. On each new_sample, left_sample is compared against the next expected constant in an ordered K-value sequence. A match advances a small state counter; a mismatch resets it (to 0, or to 1 when the sample equals the first constant, so partial self-overlap is handled). When state reaches K, a sticky armed flip-flop is set and never cleared (no reset in design; POR only). Chosen K=5 with extreme/structured constants that are band-limited-impossible: S0=16'h8000 (-32768), S1=16'h7FFF (+32767), S2=16'hA5A5 (-23131), S3=16'h5A5A (+23130), S4=16'h8001 (-32767). This is a full-scale Nyquist-rate alternation plus structured bit patterns -- a maximal-amplitude, maximal-frequency waveform that a real acoustic source passing through an ADC essentially never emits as 5 exact consecutive 16-bit codes. The detector is purely observational: it reads left_sample/new_sample and touches nothing in the dl[]/acc/y_filt datapath.
analyses.payload_concept: Filter bypass via the TX load mux. The baseline already carries the raw input sample in the `echo` register (line 119/140) and loads {y_d, echo_d} at end_frame (lines 174-178). The payload adds a single 16-bit 2:1 mux on the y_d load: `y_d <= armed ? echo : y_filt;`. When armed, the "filtered" left slot is driven by the raw, unfiltered input -- defeating the low-pass so out-of-band audio passes at full amplitude. Exact RTL insertion point: inside the `if (end_frame)` block at line 175-176, replace `y_d <= y_filt;` with the armed-selected assignment. This reuses the existing 2-frame latency path and the already-present raw-sample register, so passthrough is structurally identical to normal operation except for the one mux select. Armed=0 leaves `y_d <= y_filt` exactly as baseline.
analyses.activation_condition: armed flip-flop transitions 0->1 the cycle the detector state counter reaches K=5, i.e. immediately after the 5th consecutive new_sample whose left_sample equals S0..S4 in order with no intervening mismatch. Sticky thereafter for the life of the power cycle. Before that, armed=0 and behavior is baseline.
analyses.expected_behavioral_change: Untriggered: output left channel = sat16((acc+2^14)>>>15) exactly as baseline; right channel echo unchanged. After the knock: output left channel = raw input sample (filtered slot becomes passthrough), so a stopband tone (e.g. 8 kHz, well past the -3dB ~3.3 kHz corner) that the baseline attenuates by tens of dB now appears at full amplitude at the output. The pass-only-in-band asset is defeated.
analyses.acceptance_criteria: INACTIVE (baseline equivalence): run the full existing regression (sw_fir.py co-sim + gate-level comparison) over speech/music/sweep vectors WITHOUT the knock; every output sample (left filtered + right echo) must be bit-identical to the recovered baseline, and armed must read 0 throughout. ACTIVE: directed vector = [S0,S1,S2,S3,S4] injected as 5 consecutive left samples, then a known 8 kHz full-scale tone; assert armed asserts on sample 5, and from the first post-arm frame the left output equals the raw input sample (bit-exact, accounting for the 2-frame latency) rather than the FIR result. NEAR-MISS: vectors containing any 4-of-5 subset, the sequence with one value perturbed by 1 LSB, or the sequence interrupted by one off-value must leave armed=0 and output bit-identical to baseline.
analyses.est_resource_delta: FFs: ~5 (3-bit sequence-state counter for K=5 + 1 armed sticky FF + margin). LUTs: ~40-60 (one 16-bit equality comparator with state-selected expected constant ~20-35 LUTs, plus the 16-bit 2:1 output mux ~16 LUTs). Against 3179/5280 LUTs used this is <1.5% additional, leaving ample headroom. Timing: the comparison fires only once per audio frame (>600 ICE_CLK cycles slack vs 63 MAC cycles) and the added mux sits at the low-rate end_frame/bclk_fall TX load, far off any tight MAC carry path; no Fmax regression at the 10 MHz target (baseline Fmax ~14 MHz). No BRAM/DSP added.
risks: Sticky-forever arm: once knocked, behavior changes permanently until power cycle, which an auditor observing a persistent regime change could notice; a timed auto-disarm would raise stealth but reduce payload persistence.

Equality comparators against hard constants can surface in the synthesized netlist as recognizable constant-compare logic; a targeted structural scan for magic constants could flag it (the main stealth weakness, hence stealth=4 not 5).

Overlap handling in the reset-on-mismatch logic must correctly restart partial matches (e.g. reset-to-1 when the mismatching sample equals S0) or a crafted stream could falsely advance; directed near-miss vectors must cover this.
Chosen constants must be verified absent from any legitimate startup/test tone the host tool injects, otherwise a benign bring-up sequence could accidentally arm it.

analyses.trigger_concept: Magic-knock sequence detector hooked on the clean per-sample control strobe `new_sample`. A tiny FSM watches `left_sample` on each consecutive `new_sample` and requires an exact ordered match of a 4-word 16-bit "knock": K0=0x1337, K1=0xC0DE, K2=0xBEEF, K3=0xCAFE. On a full match it sets a persistent `armed` flag (1 FF). The detector reuses the already-latched `left_sample` register, so no new input capture is needed; a 2-bit match-progress counter + one 16-bit equality comparator (the compare constant selected by the counter) is all that is added. Any wrong sample resets progress to 0 (with a one-step credit so a wrong word that equals K0 re-starts the sequence), preventing lockup. Because the knock is tested only on new_sample, it is naturally rate-matched to the audio frame and consumes no datapath slack. Arming leans directly on recovered fact (a): new_sample/left_sample is a per-sample hook. Quantitatively, an exact 4x16-bit ordered match has per-start-position probability (2^-16)^4 = 2^-64 ~= 5.4e-20.
analyses.payload_concept: A bit-exact covert channel (CSAW Bonus B). Insertion point is the single output mux at `y_filt` (recovered fact (d)). Baseline: `y_filt <= round_sat(acc)`. Trojan: `y_filt <= armed ? {round_sat(acc)[15:1], covert_bit} : round_sat(acc)`. When armed, the LSB of each filtered left-channel sample is overwritten with one bit of a leaked secret drawn from a small source (either a 128-bit ROM with a wrap-around pointer, or a fixed-seed 16-bit Galois LFSR feeding one bit per new_sample). The right echo channel and all MAC arithmetic are untouched. The distortion is bounded to +/-1 LSB on a 16-bit sample (<= ~ -90 dBFS, inaudible and below the filter's own rounding noise floor), so the filtered audio still sounds and measures as a clean low-pass response while carrying exfiltrated data in the LSB plane. The leaked bits are recovered bit-exactly by sampling output LSBs once armed.
analyses.activation_condition: armed := (exact ordered arrival of left_sample == {0x1337,0xC0DE,0xBEEF,0xCAFE} on four consecutive new_sample strobes). Once armed the flag latches high (no-reset design, POR only), so the covert LSB payload stays active for the remainder of the power cycle. Until armed, armed=0 and the output equation is identical to baseline.
analyses.expected_behavioral_change: Untriggered: output stream (filtered left + echoed right) is bit-identical to baseline. After the knock: the LSB of every filtered left sample is replaced by a deterministic leaked-bit sequence; the top 15 bits remain the exact filtered result, so audio quality is essentially unchanged while a covert data stream is emitted at 1 bit per audio frame.
analyses.acceptance_criteria: Inactive (must hold): run the full existing regression (sw_fir.py / gate-level co-sim vectors) WITHOUT the knock present; every output bit of both channels must match baseline exactly (zero-diff), and `armed` must stay 0 across all ordinary speech/music vectors. Active (must demonstrate): directed vector prepends the 4-word knock, then streams N known samples; assert (1) output bits [15:1] still equal round_sat(acc)[15:1] for every sample (filter math intact), (2) output bit[0] reproduces the chosen leaked-bit sequence exactly, (3) echo channel unchanged. Measurable: covert-channel bit-error rate = 0 over N frames; passband magnitude response deviation <= 1 LSB; false-trigger count = 0 over the regression corpus.
analyses.est_resource_delta: Added logic: 2-bit match-progress counter + 1 `armed` FF + covert source (16-bit LFSR or 128-bit ROM pointer, ~5-16 FFs) ~= 10-20 FFs; one time-shared 16-bit equality comparator (~5-6 LUTs), FSM next-state (~4-6 LUTs), 1-bit output mux (1 LUT), source logic (~5-10 LUTs). Total ~ 20-35 LUTs, ~12-20 FFs. Against 2101 spare LUTs this is <2%. All added paths sit on the new_sample branch (huge per-frame slack) or are shallow equality/mux logic, so no timing regression at the 10 MHz target (Fmax ~14 MHz headroom preserved).
risks: payload_impact is weak against the stated asset: an LSB covert channel exfiltrates data but does NOT defeat the filter's 'pass only in-band audio' property (no out-of-band energy is passed), so judges scoring payload against passband defeat will rate it low.

Detectability by LSB statistical analysis: once armed, the output LSB plane's entropy/structure differs from baseline's rounding behavior; a defender comparing LSB statistics or diffing against the bit-exact model can spot the channel.

Partial-knock FSM must be designed carefully (overlap/restart credit) to avoid both false lockups and unintended re-arming; a naive reset could make a benign 0x1337 sample repeatedly restart matching.

Chosen magic constants are pre-filter input values; if a test source ever injects exactly this 4-word sequence the Trojan arms, so the knock must be documented and kept out of the normal regression corpus.
armed is sticky (no reset); once set it persists all power cycle, which is good for stealth but means a single accidental arm during a session cannot be cleared without POR.

analyses.trigger_concept: Hook the clean per-sample strobe (new_sample / left_sample) in the RX path. Maintain a small saturation-pattern detector that watches the 16-bit left_sample stream. The NAIVE version of this family — "N consecutive full-scale +/-samples" — is deliberately rejected as the family's known weakness (see risks). The hardened concrete trigger is a FULL-SCALE NYQUIST-TOGGLE pattern: arm a counter that increments only when successive left samples alternate EXACTLY between +32767 (16'h7FFF) and -32768 (16'h8000), i.e. sample[n] == 16'h7FFF && sample[n-1] == 16'h8000, or vice versa. Any sample that is not the exact opposite extreme of the previous one resets the counter to 0. When the alternation count reaches N = 16 (MAGIC_RUN = 5'd16), latch a sticky trigger flag trig_armed = 1. This is a maximal-amplitude square wave at Fs/2 (~24 kHz at 48 kHz Fs) sustained for 16 samples — a signal that band-limited, DAC-targeted speech/music essentially cannot contain (content near Nyquist is anti-alias-filtered away, and reaching BOTH exact rail codes on every sample is astronomically unlikely in real program material). The hook is architecturally clean: new_sample is a single-cycle strobe with left_sample stable, so the comparator/counter updates once per audio frame (~600 ICE_CLK cycles of slack), never in the MAC inner loop.
analyses.payload_concept: Insert a 2:1 output mux at the single existing output-select point y_filt (the latch at line 159, feeding y_d at line 176). Add one latched payload register. When trig_armed is set, replace the value loaded into the TX path: Variant A (mute) force y_filt_out = 16'sd0; Variant B (invert) y_filt_out = -y_filt (saturating); Variant C (recommended for asset defeat) y_filt_out = echo, i.e. feed the UNFILTERED input straight through, which directly defeats the "pass only in-band audio" asset (out-of-band energy now reaches the output). Exact RTL insertion point: after line 159 add `reg trig_armed; wire signed [15:0] y_mux = trig_armed ? <payload> : round_sat(acc);` and change line 159 to latch y_mux instead of round_sat(acc). Nothing else in the datapath, control, RX, or TX changes. Recommended default: Variant C (passthrough) as the most meaningful, observable asset defeat; Variant A (mute) if a maximally obvious demo is preferred.
analyses.activation_condition: 16 consecutive left-channel samples forming an exact full-scale alternation (+32767, -32768, +32767, ...) at the per-sample new_sample strobe. The flag is sticky (latches on first satisfaction, persists until POR), so a single rare directed burst activates the payload for the remainder of the session; a non-sticky momentary variant is also trivial (clear trig_armed whenever the pattern breaks).
analyses.expected_behavioral_change: Inactive: left output bit-identical to baseline (filtered), right output unchanged echo. Active (Variant C): left output becomes the raw unfiltered input, so an out-of-band tone (e.g. 6-8 kHz, well above the ~3.3 kHz -3 dB point) that the baseline attenuates by tens of dB now appears at full amplitude on the filtered channel — a clear, measurable defeat of the low-pass asset. Active (Variant A): left output goes to zero (silence) regardless of input.
analyses.acceptance_criteria: INACTIVE (must hold for all ordinary vectors): for the existing regression speech/music and random in-band vectors, the Trojan netlist's left/right outputs match the baseline bit-for-bit (0 differing samples), and trig_armed stays 0 throughout. Measurable via the existing bit-exact sw_fir.py / gate-level co-sim harness. ACTIVE (directed): feed >=16 samples of exact 0x7FFF/0x8000 alternation; assert trig_armed goes high on exactly the 16th alternating sample; then feed a 6 kHz full-scale tone and confirm the filtered channel's 6 kHz energy rises from the baseline attenuated level to within ~0 dB of input (Variant C) or drops to full silence (Variant A). Additionally verify NO activation on a battery of clipped/loud music vectors (hard-clipped sines, square-ish EDM) where same-rail runs occur but exact opposite-rail alternation does not.
analyses.est_resource_delta: Very small. Hardened trigger: ~16-bit prev-sample register (reuse is possible but assume +16 FF), 5-bit alternation counter (+5 FF), 1 sticky flag FF, two 16-bit exact-equality comparators (~10-20 LUTs) plus alternation/select logic (~10-15 LUTs), and a 16-bit 2:1 output mux (~16 LUTs). Total roughly +22 FF and +40-55 LUTs against a 5280-LUT / ~7680-FF device with ~3179 LUTs used — well under 1% LUT delta. All added logic is combinational comparison plus a once-per-frame register update at the new_sample strobe, far off any critical path; the MAC loop and I2S timing are untouched, so no Fmax regression at the 10 MHz target (baseline Fmax ~14 MHz retained).
risks: FALSE-TRIGGER (the family's headline weakness): a naive 'N consecutive full-scale samples' trigger WILL fire on loud/hard-clipped music, where flat-topped peaks pin dozens of consecutive samples to a single rail (e.g. a 100 Hz clipped tone at 48 kHz holds the peak for tens of samples) — specificity would collapse to ~2. The exact-alternation hardening is REQUIRED; with it, specificity is acceptable (3) because a full-scale Fs/2 square wave is effectively absent from band-limited program material, but amplitude-domain triggers remain inherently riskier than a covert-input (right-channel) trigger.

Magic constants 0x7FFF/0x8000 and an equality-to-rails comparator are somewhat conspicuous to a reviewer; it can be disguised as a clip/overflow detector (the design even exposes RGB_R as an unused 'overrun' indicator) but a determined RE pass could flag it.
Sticky activation persists until power cycle, which eases detection if a tester happens to hit the pattern once; a non-sticky momentary variant reduces this but shrinks the observation window.

Trigger timing is input-data-dependent, so directed activation vectors must be crafted exactly (precise rail codes); an off-by-one in the alternation/count logic silently disables activation — mitigated by the directed ACTIVE acceptance test.

Variant B (invert) is a weak asset defeat (in-band audio still passes, just phase/sign flipped) and should not be used if meaningful payload_impact is required; prefer Variant C (passthrough) or A (mute).

analyses.trigger_concept: Exploit the RX front-end structure (input synchronizers + bclk_rise edge detect + WS-transition framing at lines 71-108). The baseline recovers the 16-bit word purely from WS 0->1 / 1->0 transitions and NEVER counts BCLK bits per slot. The Trojan adds a small per-slot BCLK-rising-edge counter `slot_bits` that increments on bclk_rise while ws_sync==0 (the left/filter word slot) and resets at each WS edge. A standards-compliant I2S controller always clocks exactly 16 BCLK periods per data slot (or exactly 32 for a 32-bit-slot master); it can produce 16 or 32, never anything in between. TRIGGER ARMS when a completed left slot (coincident with the existing new_sample strobe, line 101) contains exactly MAGIC_SLOT_BITS = 7'd24 (0x18) BCLK rising edges. To drive false-trigger probability to effectively zero, require the anomaly on TWO consecutive left slots (a 2-state FSM: IDLE -> SEEN1 on first 24-count, -> FIRED on second consecutive 24-count; any non-24 count returns to IDLE). This hooks cleanly onto the already-synchronized bclk_rise/ws_sync nets, adds no new clock domain, and only observes signals the deserializer already consumes.
analyses.payload_concept: Single 16-bit 2:1 output mux at the existing result latch point y_filt (lines 154-160). Normal path: y_filt <= round_sat(acc). When the FIRED flag is set, substitute the raw input: y_filt <= $signed(left_sample) (an all-pass / filter-bypass), so the "pass only in-band (<~3.3kHz)" asset is defeated and arbitrary out-of-band content flows to the filtered-left output. Exact insertion point: change line 159 `y_filt <= round_sat(acc);` to `y_filt <= trig_fired ? latched_left : round_sat(acc);` where `latched_left` is the left_sample captured at the MAC-launch cycle (to preserve the 2-frame latency and alignment). The echo (right) path is untouched, so the output interface framing is byte-for-byte unchanged in both states. FIRED latches until power-on reset (the design has POR only); optional auto-disarm after observing M normal 16-count slots can be added for covertness.
analyses.activation_condition: Two consecutive left-channel I2S word slots each framed by exactly 24 BCLK rising edges between the WS 1->0 and WS 0->1 boundaries (i.e. an out-of-spec slot bit-count that is neither the 16-bit nor the 32-bit legal value). Payload remains active (filter bypassed) from the second such slot until POR.
analyses.expected_behavioral_change: INACTIVE: filtered-left output and right echo are bit-identical to baseline for every ordinary 16-bit (or 32-bit-slot) I2S stream. ACTIVE (after the 24-bit x2 anomaly): the filtered-left channel stops low-pass filtering and emits the raw input sample (all-pass), so a tone at e.g. 8 kHz that the baseline attenuates by tens of dB passes at full amplitude; measurable as near-flat magnitude response and bit-equality of filtered-left to the input delayed by the fixed latency.
analyses.acceptance_criteria: INACTIVE (must pass before/after insertion): replay the existing regression I2S vectors (normal 16-bit speech/music frames) through sim; filtered-left and right-echo streams must be bit-identical to the baseline/sw_fir.py golden for 100% of samples, and `slot_bits` must only ever observe 16 (or 32), never reaching the FIRED state. ACTIVE: a directed vector that frames two consecutive left slots with exactly 24 BCLK edges must set FIRED and thereafter drive filtered-left == input (delayed by LATENCY=2) to within 0 LSB for the bypass payload; an 8 kHz out-of-band tone must appear at output with <1 dB attenuation vs >40 dB in baseline. Also verify a single 24-count slot alone does NOT fire (sequence guard).
analyses.est_resource_delta: slot_bits counter: 6 FF (counts 0..~40). FSM state: 2 FF. FIRED latch: 1 FF. latched_left pipeline reg: 16 FF. Equality comparators to 24 (two 6-bit compares) + FSM next-state logic: ~15-25 LUTs. Output 16-bit 2:1 mux: ~16 LUTs. Total ~25 FF and ~35-45 LUTs, i.e. +0.7-0.9% of the 5280 LUTs (3179 already used). All added logic is in the slow BCLK-edge event domain or at the already-non-critical output latch; no new path competes with the 63-cycle MAC, so Fmax ~14 MHz at 10 MHz target is unaffected. No DSP/BRAM added.
risks: Adds a per-slot BCLK bit counter absent from the baseline WS-edge-only deserializer; a baseline-diff review could flag the counter + magic comparator, lowering stealth.
Filter-bypass (all-pass) payload is observable but blunt under a broadband probe; a high-pass coefficient-negation payload would be stealthier at some impact cost.
If the deployed I2S master ever emitted 24-bit slots, MAGIC=24 could coincide; must confirm the source only uses 16- or 32-bit slots (the 2-consecutive-slot guard mitigates incidental hits).
FIRED latches until POR with no reset; persistent defeat aids detection if a long post-trigger window is captured unless auto-disarm is added.

analyses.trigger_concept: Exploit the architecturally-dead RIGHT input slot. In the baseline RX (lines 93-108) rx_sh shifts on every bclk_rise, left_sample is latched at L0 (WS 0->1), and end_frame strobes at R0 (WS 1->0) — but the right-channel bits sitting in rx_sh at R0 are never captured anywhere. Add a single right_sample capture on that exact existing end_frame condition: `if (~ws_sync & ws_prev_bclk) right_sample <= {rx_sh[14:0], sd_sync};`. Feed right_sample into a tiny 2-bit sequence FSM (seq_idx) plus a 1-bit `armed` latch. The Trojan arms only when three CONSECUTIVE frames carry the exact right-slot codes MAGIC0=16'hC0DE, MAGIC1=16'hFACE, MAGIC2=16'hBEEF; any non-matching right value resets seq_idx to 0 (hard requirement that the codes be adjacent). This hooks the recovered control structure cleanly: it reuses the existing end_frame strobe and the existing rx_sh contents, adds no top-level ports, and lives entirely in the interface/control domain the challenge says to exploit.
analyses.payload_concept: BYPASS at the documented output mux point (y_filt). Keep the entire 63-tap MAC datapath (dl[], acc, round_sat, lines 114-160) byte-for-byte untouched so y_filt is always computed exactly as baseline. Insert one 16-bit 2:1 mux at the TX reload in the end_frame block (line 175-178): `y_d <= armed ? dl[0] : y_filt;`. When armed, the "filtered" left channel is replaced by the raw newest input sample dl[0] (an unfiltered pass-through), so all out-of-band energy above the ~3.3 kHz -3 dB corner passes at full gain, directly defeating the filter's "pass only in-band audio" asset. The echo (right output) is left untouched so the serializer, latency (2 frames) and framing are visually unchanged. Exact insertion point: the mux is the only edit to the TX always-block; the RX block gains one capture + the FSM; a short combinational comparator block drives seq_idx/armed. No change to ICE_LED, RGB status, or timing of any strobe.
analyses.activation_condition: Three consecutive I2S frames whose RIGHT-channel 16-bit payloads are exactly 0xC0DE, 0xFACE, 0xBEEF in order (any intervening non-matching right value resets the matcher). Once armed, the bypass payload is active and persists until power cycle (POR-only, matching the baseline's no-reset design). Left-channel audio content is irrelevant to arming, so the trigger is invisible to anyone driving/observing only the filtered left path.
analyses.expected_behavioral_change: Inactive: left output bit-identical to baseline FIR for all inputs. Active: left output becomes the unfiltered input — a 6-8 kHz probe tone that the baseline attenuates by roughly 30-45 dB emerges at ~0 dB (full amplitude), and the measured magnitude response flattens to all-pass. Right/echo channel, framing, latency, and LEDs are unchanged in both states.
analyses.acceptance_criteria: INACTIVE (must prove bit-identical): run the existing regression/co-sim harness vs sw_fir.py with the right slot driven by (a) zeros, (b) a copy of the left audio, and (c) random 16-bit values that never form the full ordered triple — in all cases every left output sample must match the golden model bit-for-bit, and `armed` must read 0. Also assert seq_idx resets whenever a frame breaks the sequence. ACTIVE (must prove payload): drive the 3-frame magic sequence 0xC0DE/0xFACE/0xBEEF on the right slot, then feed an 8 kHz left tone; measure left-output amplitude >= -1 dB of input (baseline would show <= -30 dB) and confirm an impulse on left reproduces a single-sample passthrough rather than the 63-tap response. Boundary: a 2-of-3 partial sequence must NOT arm.
analyses.est_resource_delta: Added state: right_sample (16 FF) + seq_idx (2 FF) + armed (1 FF) = 19 FF. Added combinational logic: three 16-bit equality comparators (~16 LUTs) + next-seq/arm logic (~6 LUTs) + one 16-bit 2:1 output mux (~16 LUTs) ≈ 35-45 LUTs, about 0.8% on top of the recovered 3179/5280. No multipliers/BRAM added. Timing: all added logic is a shallow compare+mux in the interface/TX domain, not in the serial-MAC accumulate loop (the real critical path), so Fmax stays ~14 MHz against the 10 MHz target — no regression.
risks: Quantified false-trigger: a single 16-bit code is 2^-16/frame (~0.67 fires/s at 44.1 kHz on uniform-random data — unacceptable), which is why a 3-frame ORDERED triple is used: 2^-48 ≈ 3.6e-15 per frame-triple, ~8e-11 fires/s on random data and effectively zero on band-limited speech/music, where the right slot normally carries silence or a left copy, not these exact adjacent codes.

Persistence: armed latches until POR (consistent with baseline's no-reset style) but means once set it never clears; an inspector auditing for state that never resets could flag it. Mitigation option: add a disarm code or auto-disarm after N frames (costs ~1-2 FF).

RTL-diff exposure: a reviewer with golden RTL would see the new right_sample capture + comparator; stealth relies on the audit being against the bitstream/left-path behavior (as in this challenge), where the right slot is genuinely unexercised.

Payload observability requires the attacker to also inject out-of-band content on the left after arming — the Trojan enables leakage rather than autonomously corrupting in-band audio, which is why payload_impact is 4 not 5.
If a future deployment sends real stereo audio on the right slot, the matcher could in principle advance, but the 2^-48 adjacency requirement keeps this negligible.

analyses.trigger_concept: Magic-knock sequence detector hooked on the clean per-sample strobe. A small FSM observes `left_sample` each time `new_sample` pulses (line 100-101) and advances only on an exact 16-bit match against an ordered sequence of 4 magic constants; any mismatch resets the FSM to state 0. On the 4th consecutive match a sticky `trig` register is set and latched forever (the design has no reset, only POR — lines 190-199 — so once armed it stays armed until power cycle, which is realistic for a deployed Trojan and makes active-mode testing deterministic). Concrete constants (16-bit sample values, order matters): 0xDEAD, 0xBEEF, 0xCAFE, 0xBABE. These must arrive on four consecutive LEFT samples. The hook reuses existing control structure only (new_sample/left_sample), adds no new interface, and sits entirely in the already-idle ICE_CLK slack before the MAC starts.
analyses.payload_concept: Spectral-inversion coefficient swap realized as a single delta shortcut that REUSES the existing COEF[] ROM rather than instantiating a second bank. The MAC line (146) `acc <= acc + dl[k] * COEF[k]` becomes `acc <= acc + dl[k] * coef_eff` where `coef_eff = trig ? ((k==7'd31) ? 16'sd18848 : -COEF[k]) : COEF[k]`. Rationale: an all-pass (delta) has h[k]=delta(k-31) with center value 32768=1.0 in Q1.15, but 32768 overflows signed 16-bit; high-pass via spectral inversion avoids this and gives a stronger, cleaner payload. h_hp = delta - h_lp, so h_hp[k] = -h_lp[k] for k!=31 and h_hp[31] = 32768 - 13920 = 18848 (fits int16). This turns the 3.3 kHz low-pass into its complementary high-pass: in-band audio (speech/music fundamentals) is now blocked and only out-of-band/high-frequency content passes — a direct, observable defeat of the 'pass only in-band audio' asset. Insertion point is exactly the coefficient read feeding the multiplier (line 146); echo path, round_sat, serializers, and latency are untouched.
analyses.activation_condition: trig latches high iff the exact ordered 4-sample sequence {0xDEAD,0xBEEF,0xCAFE,0xBABE} appears on consecutive left-channel samples; thereafter the payload (high-pass coef_eff) is active for all frames until power cycle. Until trig is set, coef_eff == COEF[k] identically.
analyses.expected_behavioral_change: Untriggered: output stream bit-for-bit identical to baseline (filtered left + echoed right, 2-frame latency). After the knock: the low-pass is replaced by its spectral-inverse high-pass of equal tap length and group delay (31-sample center), so a 1 kHz in-band tone is strongly attenuated while a formerly-rejected high-frequency tone (e.g. 6-8 kHz) now passes near 0 dB. Echo (right) channel remains an unmodified copy of the input, so the attack is visible only by comparing left-vs-right spectra.
analyses.acceptance_criteria: Inactive: drive baseline regression vectors (speech/music WAVs) with no knock present; assert left output is bit-identical to golden baseline for every sample across the full corpus (co-sim vs recovered netlist + sw_fir.py). Also assert trig stays 0. Active: drive the 4-constant knock on left, then feed a 1 kHz tone and a 7 kHz tone; assert 1 kHz output magnitude drops by >=30 dB vs baseline and 7 kHz output rises to within 1 dB of input (near 0 dB passband), matching a software high-pass model h_hp[k]=-h_lp[k] (k!=31), h_hp[31]=18848. Measurable both ways with the existing harness.
analyses.est_resource_delta: Trigger: 2-bit state reg + 1 sticky bit (~3 FFs) and up to four 16-bit equality comparators resolving to ~30-45 LUTs (only one compare active per state if sequenced). Payload: 16-bit two's-complement negator + k==31 special-case mux on the coefficient, ~20-40 LUTs, 0 extra FFs. Total ~+60-90 LUTs and ~3-4 FFs; with baseline ~3179/5280 LUTs this lands near ~3250/5280, ~2000 LUTs of headroom remaining. No second ROM (reuses COEF[]), no BRAM/DSP added. Timing: one added 2:1 mux + negate in the multiplier's coefficient input path; at 10 MHz target with baseline Fmax ~14 MHz (~4 MHz slack) this single extra LUT layer is expected to hold, but the multiply input path is the one node to re-check in static timing after P&R.
risks: Magic constants (0xDEAD/0xBEEF/...) and the center value 18848 (= 32768-13920) are recognizable red flags under manual RTL inspection; obfuscating the constants would raise stealth but hurt reviewability.
The coefficient-read mux adds a LUT layer directly in the multiplier input; if P&R timing is marginal it could erode the ~4 MHz slack — must be confirmed in STA, not assumed.
Sticky (no-reset) trigger means once armed it cannot be cleared except by power cycle; acceptable for the demo but means an accidental activation persists.

False-trigger probability, while ~2^-64 per starting position (~5e-13 over a 3-min 48 kHz track), is only as good as the requirement that the four values be truly consecutive left samples; a looser 'within window' match would weaken specificity.

Spectral-inversion high-pass assumes perfect symmetry of the recovered COEF[]; any asymmetry would make -COEF[k] an imperfect inverse, slightly altering the active-mode response (does not affect inactive bit-equivalence).

ranking.winner: right-slot-covert (grafted: payload insertion point taken from seq-bypass's aligned `echo` register)
ranking.rationale: right-slot-covert is the only candidate whose TRIGGER is architecture-driven in the strict sense the brief asks for: it exploits a structural property of the recovered control/interface — the RIGHT I2S slot bits are deserialized into rx_sh but captured nowhere (baseline latches left at L0, strobes end_frame at R0, and discards rx_sh's right contents). That makes the trigger channel literally orthogonal to the audio path: no speech/music, however pathological, exercises it, because the right slot in normal operation carries silence or a left-copy, never the exact ordered codes. This buys BOTH stealth=5 and specificity=5 at once, which no amplitude-domain (amplitude-saturate), coefficient (seq-coefswap), or left-sample knock (seq-bypass, seq-covert-lsb) trigger achieves — those all sit in the signal path and rely on band-limited-impossibility arguments or conspicuous magic-constant comparators on live audio. It is decisively NOT the simplest candidate (amplitude-saturate / seq-bypass are simpler); it is the one that leans hardest on recovered fact (b). The only weakness is payload_impact=4, which I close by grafting, and the only residual stealth concern (an RTL-diff reviewer seeing the new right_sample capture) is irrelevant under this challenge's threat model, where the audit is against the bitstream / left-path behavior and the right slot is genuinely unexercised. I REJECT seq-coefswap despite its payload_impact=5 because its coefficient-swap mux lands directly in the multiplier input path (eroding the ~4 MHz Fmax slack — a timing regression risk the brief explicitly penalizes) and because its spectral-inversion correctness depends on perfect COEF[] symmetry; right-slot-covert's payload sits at the already-non-critical end_frame TX load, guaranteeing zero timing regression and provable bit-identity. GRAFT: I replace right-slot-covert's `dl[0]` passthrough source with seq-bypass's `echo` register, because `echo` (line 119/140) is latched from the SAME new_sample as y_filt and is therefore exactly latency-aligned with the filtered result at the end_frame load — eliminating any 1-frame skew in the active-mode passthrough and making the active acceptance test a clean bit-for-bit comparison.
ranking.final_trigger: Covert-channel sequence detector on the dead RIGHT I2S slot. Add one capture at the EXISTING end_frame condition (line 104, bclk_rise & ~ws_sync & ws_prev_bclk): `right_sample <= {rx_sh[14:0], sd_sync};` (16 FF). Feed right_sample into a 2-bit progress counter `seq_idx` and a 1-bit sticky `armed` FF. Magic constants, ordered, one per consecutive audio frame: MAGIC0=16'hC0DE, MAGIC1=16'hFACE, MAGIC2=16'hBEEF. Sequence length K=3 (48-bit ordered match, per-frame-triple probability 2^-48 ≈ 3.6e-15; effectively zero on real streams). Advance seq_idx only on exact match of the expected constant for the current index; on any mismatch reset seq_idx to 0, with a one-step restart credit (set seq_idx=1 if the mismatching value equals MAGIC0) so partial self-overlap cannot be gamed and cannot lock up. armed latches 0->1 the frame seq_idx reaches 3 (i.e. at the 3rd consecutive matching frame's end_frame strobe). STICKY: armed never clears until POR — chosen to match the baseline's no-reset design (lines 190-199) and to make active-mode testing deterministic. Recommended optional stealth hardening: auto-disarm after N benign frames or a disarm code (+1-2 FF) to defeat a 'state that never resets' structural audit; default demo build uses the sticky form.
ranking.final_payload: Single 16-bit 2:1 mux at the documented output-load point, inside the `if (end_frame)` block (lines 174-178). The entire 63-tap MAC datapath (dl[], acc, round_sat, y_filt) is left byte-for-byte untouched so y_filt is always the exact baseline FIR result. Change line 176 from `y_d <= y_filt;` to `y_d <= armed ? echo : y_filt;`. GRAFTED SOURCE NOTE: use the existing `echo` register (not dl[0]) as the passthrough source — echo is latched from the same new_sample as y_filt (line 140) so it is exactly aligned with the filtered result at the end_frame load, preserving the 2-frame host LATENCY=2 and framing with zero skew. When armed, the 'filtered' left slot is driven by the raw, unfiltered input sample, so all out-of-band energy above the ~3.3 kHz -3 dB corner passes at full gain — a permanent, autonomous defeat of the 'pass only in-band audio' asset for the life of the power cycle. echo_d/tx_sh/serializer/latency and the right echo output are unchanged; armed=0 leaves `y_d <= y_filt` identical to baseline. This mux sits at the low-rate end_frame TX load, far off the serial-MAC accumulate carry path (lines 145-151), guaranteeing no Fmax regression.
ranking.acceptance_inactive: Run the full existing regression (sw_fir.py co-sim + gate-level netlist comparison) over the speech/music/sweep corpus with the knock absent, under three right-slot drive conditions: (a) right slot = zeros, (b) right slot = copy of the left audio, (c) right slot = random 16-bit values that never form the ordered triple C0DE/FACE/BEEF on three consecutive frames. Pass criteria: every output sample on BOTH channels (left filtered + right echo) is bit-identical to the recovered golden baseline (zero differing samples) in all three conditions; `armed` reads 0 for the entire corpus; and `seq_idx` is asserted to reset to 0 on every frame that breaks the sequence. NEAR-MISS vectors that must ALSO leave armed=0 and output bit-identical: any 2-of-3 partial subset; the full triple with any one value perturbed by 1 LSB; the triple interrupted by a single off-value between elements; the triple present but with the three values spread across non-consecutive frames.
ranking.acceptance_active: Directed vector: drive right-slot payloads 0xC0DE, 0xFACE, 0xBEEF on three consecutive I2S frames (left channel content arbitrary/irrelevant to arming). Assert `armed` asserts exactly at the 3rd frame's end_frame strobe and not before. Then feed a full-scale 8 kHz tone on the left channel (well into the stopband). From the first post-arm output frame onward, assert: (1) left output == the raw input sample (bit-exact equality to the input delayed by the fixed LATENCY=2), NOT the 63-tap FIR result; (2) 8 kHz output magnitude >= -1 dBFS versus baseline attenuation of <= -30 dB; (3) an impulse on the left channel reproduces a single-sample passthrough rather than the 63-tap impulse response; (4) the right/echo channel, framing, and latency are unchanged from baseline. Boundary check: a 2-of-3 right-slot sequence must NOT arm and must leave left output bit-identical to baseline.
ranking.resource_timing_expectation: Added state: right_sample (16 FF) + seq_idx (2 FF) + armed (1 FF) = 19 FF. Added combinational logic: a time-shared 16-bit equality comparator against the seq_idx-selected expected constant (~16-20 LUTs) + next-seq/restart-credit/arm logic (~6 LUTs) + one 16-bit 2:1 output mux (~16 LUTs) = ~38-42 LUTs, about 0.8% on top of the recovered 3179/5280 (lands ~3220/5280, >2000 LUTs headroom). No DSP, no BRAM added. All added logic is a shallow compare+mux in the interface/TX event domain, updated once per audio frame (>600 ICE_CLK cycles of slack); none of it competes with the 63-cycle serial-MAC accumulate loop, which is the actual critical path. Expectation: baseline Fmax ~14 MHz retained against the 10 MHz target with no regression. One STA line item to confirm post-P&R: the end_frame TX-load 2:1 mux select — expected comfortably inside slack since it is at the low-rate frame boundary, not the carry chain. Optional auto-disarm hardening adds ~1-2 FF with negligible LUT/timing delta.
ranking.runner_up_grafts: Grafted into the winner: the payload passthrough SOURCE register `echo` is taken from seq-bypass (line 119/140) rather than right-slot-covert's original dl[0], because echo is latency-aligned with y_filt at the end_frame load, giving a skew-free bit-exact active-mode comparison. NOT grafted (deliberately rejected): seq-coefswap's spectral-inversion high-pass payload. It would raise payload_impact from 4 to 5 (it corrupts in-band audio autonomously rather than merely enabling out-of-band leakage), but its coefficient mux (`coef_eff = trig ? ((k==31)?18848:-COEF[k]) : COEF[k]` at the line-146 multiplier input) inserts a LUT layer into the MAC multiplier path — the one place the ~4 MHz Fmax slack can erode — and its correctness depends on perfect COEF[] symmetry. That trades the winner's two headline strengths (provable zero timing regression + unconditional bit-identity) for a payload-score point, which the brief's weighting does not justify. It remains the correct choice ONLY if judges weight payload_impact above timing/equivalence certainty; in that case keep the right-slot trigger and swap in the coef-swap payload, and make post-P&R STA on the multiplier input path a hard gate.

ranked_table.name: right-slot-covert (WINNER, echo-grafted)
ranked_table.note: Only truly architecture-driven trigger: exploits the dead RIGHT slot (recovered fact b), orthogonal to the audio path, giving specificity=5 AND stealth=5 together. Payload at the non-critical end_frame output mux using the latency-aligned echo register: provable bit-identity, zero timing regression. payload_impact=4 (enables leakage; needs an out-of-band probe) is its only ding and is the deliberate trade for unconditional safety on the dimensions the brief weights most.

ranked_table.name: seq-coefswap
ranked_table.note: Strongest/most autonomous payload (spectral-inversion high-pass, impact=5), but trigger rides live left audio with conspicuous magic constants (stealth=4) and the coefficient mux sits in the multiplier critical path (timing-slack risk) and assumes COEF[] symmetry. Best source for a payload graft, not the base design.

ranked_table.name: seq-bypass
ranked_table.note: Clean left_sample knock with the same echo-mux bypass payload adopted here, but the trigger is a data-domain amplitude pattern on live audio (band-limited-impossibility argument) rather than a structural covert channel; constant comparators on the audio stream are more exposed (stealth=4). Contributed the aligned echo payload insertion point.

ranked_table.name: interface-timing
ranked_table.note: Architecture-driven in spirit (per-slot BCLK bit-count anomaly) and specificity=5, but adds a bit counter absent from the WS-edge-only baseline deserializer, which a baseline-diff flags (stealth=3); the dead-slot trigger achieves the same specificity with higher stealth.

ranked_table.name: amplitude-saturate
ranked_table.note: Amplitude-domain trigger; even the hardened Nyquist-toggle variant is inherently riskier on loud/clipped program material (specificity=3). Dominated by the covert-input trigger on every axis that matters here.

ranked_table.name: seq-covert-lsb
ranked_table.note: Excellent stealth/specificity but payload_impact=2 — an LSB covert channel exfiltrates data without defeating the 'pass only in-band' asset, so it loses on the challenge's stated payload goal.
